Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.Name: Industrial works
Placemaker.Recipe.IndustrialWorks.Descri: Combined industrial sites: a plant, skips, bays, wrecks and containers, each in its own block of one planned works.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.style.Tooltip: What the yard is for. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is. It fills from the main aisle outward, row by row, so a part-full yard still looks tidy.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the drive aisles between the blocks: wide enough for trucks and forklifts.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.office.Toolti: The office row and the gate booth by the way in.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.parking.Toolt: A row of parked cars on the other side of the way in.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.weighbridge.T: A concrete weighbridge across the way in, just inside the gate.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.edge.Tooltip: What lines the inside of the fence: a screen of trees, a wall of concrete blocks, a wall of containers (back and sides only) or plain gravel.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.fence.Tooltip: A security fence round the yard with a gap at the gate.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.ground.Toolti: Concrete lays a slab over the yard. Gravel and dirt paint the ground itself: mud along the aisles, oily ground round the heaps and machines, dry grass along the fence. The aisles are always asphalt and whatever stands on the ground gets a concrete pad.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain: the yard ground, mud where the wheels go, oil-soaked ground round the heaps, worn dirt under the rows, dry grass at the fence. Permanent.
Placemaker.IndustrialWorks.spoil.Tooltip: Mounds of dirt in the corners no block fits, painted, with a dead tree and dead bushes on them. Raises real terrain. Permanent.
